response.sql: WITH account_avg_trans AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) as avg_trans_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), account_with_region AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 as region, aat.avg_trans_amount FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN account_avg_trans aat ON a.account_id = aat.account_id), region_avg AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_trans_amount) as region_figure FROM account_with_region GROUP BY region), all_region_avg AS (SELECT AVG(region_figure) as overall_average FROM region_avg) SELECT r.region, r.region_figure, r.region_figure - ara.overall_average as exceeds_average, r.region_figure / ara.overall_average as figure_ratio FROM region_avg r CROSS JOIN all_region_avg ara WHERE r.region_figure > ara.overall_average ORDER BY r.region
